title: Gas compressed in a water bath
change: Compression instead of expansion, new context (water bath); same isothermal ΔU = 0 idea; distractors are work-only, heat-only and adiabatic confusions.

title: Heat absorbed in isothermal expansion
change: Quantitative first-law version: new numbers (2.0 mol, 300 K, 1200 J); asks for Q given ΔU = 0.

title: Internal energy change when expanding at constant pressure
change: Isobaric rather than isothermal; tests that U of an ideal gas tracks temperature (U = 3/2 PV); numbers new.

title: Cooling coffee
change: New context (coffee in room air); same conceptual explanation (entropy increase gives direction of spontaneous heat flow); distractors from energy-conservation and per-object entropy misconceptions.

title: Two blocks reaching equilibrium
change: Isolated-system equilibrium version; asks for the whole-system entropy at equilibrium rather than the reason for direction.

title: Freezer making ice
change: Closed-system entropy decrease with compensating surroundings; same second-law concept at higher reasoning demand.

title: Field from force on negative test charge
change: Negative test charge with force given; new numbers; asks for magnitude and direction of E.

title: Force on a charge in a downward field
change: Reverse direction of the definition: field given, find force on a negative charge; new numbers and orientation.

title: Net field between opposite charges
change: Opposite-sign superposition at a midpoint with numbers; hard because the like-charge cancellation habit must be overridden.

title: Negative charge moved along the field
change: Negative charge moved along the field (sign flip of the seed's positive charge against the field); tests the same work-and-PE sign reasoning.

title: Proton moved against a field
change: Quantitative version with a proton and new numbers (0.050 m, 2.0 × 10³ N/C).

title: Separating a proton and an electron
change: Two-point-charge PE with opposite signs; hard because U is negative and the change must be signed correctly.

title: Two equal negative charges
change: Negative charges on a vertical line; same symmetric-superposition cancellation idea with a changed sign and orientation.

title: Zero-field point between unequal charges
change: Unequal like charges: locate zero-field point; extends the seed's cancellation idea quantitatively.

title: Field on the perpendicular bisector
change: Off-axis superposition of two identical charges; hard because cancellation is only partial.

title: Two resistors in parallel
change: New values (4.0 Ω and 12 Ω); same two-resistor parallel equivalent; distractors are averaging, series sum and product.

title: Three parallel resistors
change: Three resistors in parallel with a clean reciprocal sum; extends the same skill.

title: Series-parallel network
change: Compound series-parallel network; asks for equivalent resistance as in the seed but needs both rules.

title: Heating coil resistance
change: New context (heating coil), new numbers (120 V, 5.0 A); same unknown (R) and same skill, distractors are inverted ratio, subtraction and product.

title: Current through a resistor
change: Unknown switches to current, battery-and-resistor context, new numbers (9.0 V, 45 Ω); distractors invert, subtract or multiply.

title: Ohmic resistor at higher voltage
change: Proportional reasoning with an ohmic resistor instead of a single-step R = V/I; new values (0.30 A, 1.5 V to 6.0 V); distractors inverse, unchanged and additive.

title: Initial current into capacitor
change: Numerical initial-current version with new values (12 V, 400 Ω, 50 μF); same idea that an uncharged capacitor acts like a wire at t = 0.

title: Resistor voltage after long time
change: Asks the long-time rather than initial state; new context and values (9.0 V); same topic and same use of initial versus steady-state capacitor behavior.

title: Discharge current at start
change: Discharging direction instead of charging; the capacitor acts like a source at t = 0; new values (20 V, 2.0 kΩ); distractors target open-circuit and time-constant percentage misuse.

title: Tripling gas in a rigid tank
change: New context (helium tank), tripling instead of doubling; distractors inverse, squared and volume-only reasoning.

title: Heating a sealed gas sample
change: Temperature instead of molecule count is varied, with a Celsius-to-kelvin conversion; same PV = Nk_BT proportional reasoning.

title: Compressing a leaking gas
change: Two simultaneous changes (N and V) at constant T instead of a single change; same proportional reasoning from PV = Nk_BT.

title: Doubled temperature difference
change: Temperature difference varied instead of conductivity; copper bars context and new numbers (40 K and 80 K).

title: Thicker glass pane
change: Thickness (L, inverse dependence) instead of conductivity; window context.

title: Comparing two rods
change: Three geometry and material factors change at once; same kAΔT/L proportional reasoning.

title: Ice melting in warm water
change: Thermal equilibration of ice and water instead of mixing of gases; same idea that isolated systems move toward higher entropy.

title: Freezer and the second law
change: Local entropy decrease in a non-isolated system, as opposed to a spontaneous mixing process; same second-law qualitative reasoning.

title: Free expansion of a gas
change: Free expansion in an isolated box instead of mixing two gases; entropy increase without heat flow plus irreversibility.

title: Charged ball touches neutral ball
change: Negative charge on a metal ball touching a neutral one, new numbers (−8.0 nC); distractors no transfer, duplication and induced opposite charge.

title: Opposite charges on contact
change: Unlike charges of unequal magnitude, requiring the sign of the net charge; new values (+9.0 and −3.0 nC).

title: Sequential contacts with three spheres
change: Two sequential contacts among three identical spheres, requiring repeated conservation and equal sharing.

title: Zero potential at a dipole midpoint
change: New context: opposite charges, midpoint, new numbers and a quantitative field; same idea that V = 0 at a point does not force E = 0.

title: Field where the potential crosses zero
change: New context: field read from a potential-vs-position description; same concept that V = 0 at a point leaves E set by the spatial change of V.

title: Zero potential between unequal charges
change: New context: unequal charges, zero-potential position must be located first; same concept that V = 0 does not force E = 0.

title: Proton accelerated through 500 V
change: New particle (proton) and new voltage; same work-energy relation ΔK = |q|ΔV.

title: Electron speed after 250 V
change: New task: convert the energy gain eΔV into a speed with new voltage; same relation ΔK = |q|ΔV.

title: Electron moving to higher potential
change: New context: electron moving to higher potential from nonzero starting potential, requiring the sign of q·ΔV; same skill as the seed.

title: Current tripled in a resistor
change: New variable held (current instead of voltage) and factor 3; same P = I²R = V²/R dependence at fixed R.

title: Heater on a lower voltage
change: New context: heater, numbers 360 W / 120 V / 60 V, requires scaling from a given power; same V²/R relationship.

title: Series resistors power comparison
change: New two-resistor series comparison; same power relations P = I²R and P = V²/R chosen according to what is held fixed.

title: Loop rule for an unknown resistor
change: New numbers and an unknown-resistor task; same loop-rule sign convention (rise through battery from − to +, drops through resistors).

title: Two opposing batteries
change: New context: two batteries in opposition; same sign convention for battery terms in a loop equation.

title: Potential partway around a loop
change: New task: track potential at a point in a loop; same loop-rule sign convention for battery rise and resistor drop.

title: Current into a three-wire junction
change: New context: one inflow and two known outflows with different numbers; same junction rule ΣI_in = ΣI_out.

title: Four-wire junction
change: New context: circuit-board node with two inflows and two outflows; same junction rule.

title: Battery current into parallel branches
change: New context: junction rule applied to branch currents from Ohm's law; same junction-rule skill.

title: Instant after closing the switch
change: New numbers and the opposite time limit (t = 0 rather than long time); same RC-circuit initial/final-state reasoning.

title: Capacitor voltage at steady state
change: New circuit with extra resistors; same long-time capacitor-as-open-circuit reasoning, asked via the capacitor's potential difference.

title: Charge after one time constant
change: New numbers; requires computing τ and the final charge and applying the 63% meaning of τ; same RC-circuit time-behavior concept.
